name: Sales closing - positive response after quote
description: Customer gets a quote and gives a positive response. AI should attempt a direct close.

messages.text: My name is Close Test, can I get a quote for 20 sheets of white melamine chipboard 16mm

expected_behaviors.description: AI should attempt a sales close after customer expresses interest
Second reply should arrive within 15 seconds

forbidden_patterns.description: Close attempt tags should be stripped from customer-facing message

notes: Customer gives a positive but non-committal response. AI should attempt a direct close by asking for the order or confirming the deal.
